prompt: Illustration painted and inked BY HAND on a wood panel — visible wood grain, matte paint, HAND-DRAWN LINE with natural wobble and imperfection. Loose, illustrative, storybook, NOT crisp vector. Simple big flat shapes, generous empty space, high contrast. Palette strictly: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white line, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. NO human figures. No text, no lettering, no glyphs. THE SOURCE: a vast hand-hatched volcano at night, black slopes drawn in loose pen hatching, a bright BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN glow in its crater. Glowing green VEINS run out from the volcano beneath the pale ground — branching underground channels of green light visible as glowing seams and cracks across the plain — travelling toward a tiny distant village of cabins with green windows, and toward a small standing stone whose cable disappears into one of the seams. Two tiny black creatures with spiral ears and glowing green eyes stand watching from a ridge in the foreground. Immense scale, quiet, lots of empty space.
